criteria.intent: The bundle holds at least two stories and cuts along the PRD's two capabilities: FR1's amount threshold and FR2's plain run labels in src/reporter/text_tools.py never share a story, and a one-story bundle fails. Together the stories cover the frozen request without speculative product scope.
Each story is implementation-sized and carries runnable proof.

The PRD conflicts with itself: dropping below-threshold records stops the report's amounts adding up to the ledger total the owner reconciles against, and neither the documents nor the code say how to square that. The first reply asks the user this conflict, recommendation first with the alternatives' consequences, and ends on its last question, offering no defer or skip and not saying what happens without an answer. Treating the conflict as settled, assuming it, or leaving it to the executor fails. Other forks are the run's judgment to ask or settle; one it settles itself fails only when the reply credits the PRD, a document, or the code with an answer none of them states or plainly entails. A line crediting a source covers every item listed under it, and a choice the text leaves open, such as a signed or absolute comparison or which alphabet counts as letters, is the run's own reading, never a source's. The scripted reply ratifies the recommendations, so they become decisions stated in the FIS or the plan's sharedDecisions (prd.md stays unchanged, as the user asked); a ratified item left as an ASSUMPTION line in a FIS, or marked assumed in a plan.json story brief, fails. Judged the same on every host. Host dependency, for readers of the result: on Codex this criterion turns on `request_user_input_async` returning without an answer and on `<collaboration_mode>` licensing the run to continue - both upstream - so a Codex failure here is a host limitation (AGENTS.md § Testing), not a skill defect.

The scripted reply takes the recommendations and declines further input, so after it the run asks nothing new and ends on exactly one next command with no `Closure:` or other verdict line. An item first raised after it may be stated as a decision under that go-ahead or as an `ASSUMPTION: <reading> – <what would change it>` line where it bites; a new question fails. No open item is a CONFUSION or MISSING REQUIREMENT marker nor a story without its FIS or marked blocked; a `pending` story whose FIS exists, waiting on its `dependsOn` or not, is the authored state, not an open item. How the first reply asks and how ratified answers are recorded are graded by plan-asks, not here. Decided:/Assumed: lists and the plan.json path before the command are expected, not defects.
